newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN DATA DUE - Jan Ifo index expected Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN DATA DUE - Jan Ifo index expected Feb 20.

text.p: Germany's Ifo economic research institute is expected to release its closely watched business climate index for January on Thursday next week, February 20.
A spokeswoman for Ifo said the data would likely be released at 0900 GMT.
In December, Ifo's west German index fell to 95.8 from 96.9 in November while the east German index slipped to 104.4 points from 104.8.
